content.short: Swappin.gifts lets users buy thousands of gift cards with crypto on Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, and Avalanche.
content.description: Swappin.gifts is a Web3 shopping solution available in 50+ countries that lets users convert crypto into goods and services. The dapp enables purchasing thousands of gift cards using a wide range of cryptocurrencies on Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, and Avalanche. Built on Web3 with decentralized settlement rails, Swappin.gifts serves as a global off-ramp for everyday purchases. It supports Web3-connected wallets across four major chains: Ethereum, Polygon, BNB Chain, and Avalanche.
content.meta: Swappin.gifts is a Web3 shopping dapp that converts crypto to thousands of gift cards. Discover Swappin.gifts and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
